newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters stake in German tax publisher.
newsitem.headline: Wolters stake in German tax publisher.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Tuesday it was taking an unspecified majority stake in AAV, a tax publisher based in Mannheim, Germany.
The Dutch company said AAV (Akademische Arbeitsgemeinschaft Verlagsgesellschaft) had annual sales of some 40 million marks or 45 million guilders.
It did not disclose financial details of the transaction.
Wolters said the acquisition was in line with its policy of expanding in Germany -- particularly in the legal and tax markets -- where it posted 1996 sales of over 200 million marks.
AAV has a staff of 50 people and publishes tax information for professionals and wealthy individuals.
It uses direct marketing techniques to sell its products which are presented in traditional book and loose-leaf formats and in electronic formats such as CD-ROM and computer diskettes.
